rv.q: I'm happy to say that the new one, The House of Ideas , is the best of the three.
The best part is recognizing bits of Kirby and Lee in their fictional creations.
"House of Ideas" gives a fount of comic book genius, Stan Lee and Jack Kirby, their due.

“House of Ideas,” the final installment of Mark Pracht’s “Four Color Trilogy” (so named for the four-color plates traditionally used to illustrate comic books) is a knockout production worthy of being City Lit Theater’s one-hundred and fiftieth production.
To successfully inform the audience, the tale needs to be told from the viewpoint of the panel at Comicon rather than by employing an all-knowing, all-seeing narrator/observer.
